title: 2020 Lexus RX350 Review // Some updates for 2020
description:
#LexusRX
#Lexus
#RX350
The 2020 Lexus RX350 gets some nice updates to soften the look and to add more connectivity.New for 2020, Lexus gives the RX series a sleeker new look, starting with a redefined front grille, redesigned LED headlights and rear LED taillights plus new styled wheel. The biggest change up front is a softer, less sharp front design, most noticeable at the bottom corners of the front spoiler where the large air inlets and fog lights rest. What is still here is the sharp character line that runs down the side. Updated on all models is a new touchscreen and Lexus Remote touchpad plus two extra USB outlets in the rear.  The standard Lexus Display Audio is an 8” touchscreen  but there is an available 12.3-inch high resolution split-screen touchscreen, plus  six USB ports throughout the RX. Under the hood is a carried over 295hp 3.5L V6 engine with an eight-speed automatic plus standard Dynamic Torque Control AWD and sequential shift .The 2020 Lexus RX 350 comes with  the Lexus Premium Package. This model features a new 18” alloy wheel design, cargo area lamp with new LED source, heated and ventilated front row seats, heated second row seats,  Lexus Smart Key System with Push Button Start, a power rear door  rain-sensing wipers and LED headlamps. The F SPORT Series 2 gets new features for 2020, including a 12.3” full colour touchscreen, LED fog lamps, and Lexus Navigation with Remote. The Sport-L-shaped premium headlamps, cornering lamps and premium LED rear combination lamps. F SPORT models get  Adaptive Variable Suspension and F SPORT-styled leather seating, leather steering wheel with paddle shifters, shift knob, meters, scuff plates, front grille and 20” alloy wheels. The F SPORT Series 3,  New for this year, this model includes the kick sensor power back door. Other upgrades  include a panoramic glass roof, panoramic view monitor, power folding rear seats, a head-up display, wireless charging system for compatible personal electronics, and a 15 speaker Mark Levinson Audio system.

title: 2020 Lexus RX 350 Road Test & Review vs. The 2020 Acura MDX
description:
Looking for a helpful video review of the 2020 RX 350 vs. the 2020 Acura MDX? This is it. Join car enthusiast Bradley Hasemeyer for an informative and entertaining head-to-head vehicle matchup between these two leading luxury SUVs.

We all want premium styling, great standard features and satisfying driving experiences. But with so many luxury SUVs offering seemingly similar qualities, differentiating between them can be challenging. This engaging video sheds light on the key differences between the Lexus RX 350 and Acura MDX.

How does the Precision Concept-inspired styling of the Acura 3-row SUV compare to the aggressive design of the Lexus SUV? We’ll review exteriors from front grilles to exhaust outlets. How do the Jewel Eye® LED headlights and luxurious cockpit in the MDX compare to their counterparts in the RX 350? We'll review stylistic and interior choices for both. Which SUV makes longer trips easier, especially for large families? We’ll drive the Acura MDX and Lexus RX 350 to compare horsepower, steering, handling, road comfort and more. Not only will you discover key technologies that make the MDX a great midsize luxury SUV to drive like its 9 speed automatic transmission, paddle shifters and available Super Handling All Wheel Drive™, you’ll also learn about helpful features on the MDX that make it easy to accommodate passengers.

All in all, the 2020 Lexus RX 350 and the 2020 Acura MDX are both great SUVs from desirable luxury car brands. But only one should be at the top of your wish list. Watch this video review comparison now to see why the MDX is the best SUV in 2020 for the money.

title: 2020 Lexus RX 350 F-Sport 3 with Mark Levinson, sport appearance, HUD and kick tailgate.
description:
The new 2020 RX takes its exquisite blend of style, substance and performance to a new level with refined styling, more advanced connectivity, and greater safety than ever before. Choose from four dynamic models, including the two-row Lexus RX 350 and 450h Hybrid Electric, or three-row RX 350L and RX 450hL Hybrid Electric. Then tailor RX to match your style and lifestyle with a series of packages, including F SPORT  2 and 3.
Compatible with Apple CarPlay™ and Android Auto™
 
Lexus Display Audio with Remote including 8” Touchscreen, 12-speakers, and Enform Remote, Service Connect and Safety Connect
 Available Lexus Navigation with Remote including 12.3” Touchscreen and Destination Assist
 Available Heated & Ventilated Leather Front Seats
 Standard Lexus Safety System+ 2.0 and Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross Traffic Alert
 Available with Luxury Package, Executive Package, and F SPORT Series 2 and 3
For 2020, RX’s chiselled exterior gets a bold new outlook, starting with a refined front grille. Redesigned front LED headlights, fog lights, and rear taillights deepen the Lexus design signature with a pronounced L motif. Newly designed 18” and available 20” wheels anchor the corners. Now available in a striking Moonbeam Beige Metallic exterior finish.
RX’s exterior design also adds to its dynamic handling and supple ride. The side grilles above the fog lamps have been reshaped for better aerodynamics. While a precisely honed character line runs from front to rear, creating an arrow-like profile with the flowing roofline to minimize drag, reduce noise and lend stability at high speeds.
Lexus Display Audio with Remote offers a new dimension of convenience and connectivity with features that include an 8” touchscreen display and 12 speakers. It is compatible with Apple CarPlay™ and Android Auto™. Giving you easy access to your favorite apps, music, navigation and more. And, for the first time, it also includes Enform Remote and Enform Service Connect, along with Enform Safety Connect. Standard on RX 350, 350L, 450h and 450h L.
Control your Lexus from a distance with features like remote start, lock/unlock, and the ability to check the status of doors, windows and panoramic roof. GPS-enabled, you can also quickly find your vehicle in a crowded parking lot.
Have vehicle health reports, service alerts and your maintenance schedule at your fingertips via the Lexus app.
Next level peace of mind with Automatic Collision Notification, Stolen Vehicle Locator, Emergency Assistance Button, and Enhanced Roadside Assistance.
Building on Lexus Audio with Remote, the available Lexus Navigation with Enform Remote elevates your experience even more by featuring a 12.3” touch colour display screen, embedded navigation, embedded traffic and weather along with 3 years of map updates. It also includes the ultimate convenience of Destination Assist, which offers 24/7 access to a live agent who can help you find the best route, find sites of local interest, make reservations, and more. Standard on RX models equipped with Luxury, Executive, or F SPORT  packages.
Thrill to the power of commanding performance. RX 350’s 3.5-litre V6 – which requires only regular gas – has been tuned to 295 HP. And 290 HP on 350 RXL. While self-charging hybrid models generate 308 Net HP in combination with an advanced electric motor and an Atkinson-cycle V6. RX 350 and RX 450h are both available with dynamic F SPORT  packages
Drive Mode Select gives improved acceleration and steering performance with three distinct drive modes – Eco, Normal, and Sport S – to match your mood and the terrain. F SPORT  packages adds an additional Sport S+ Mode as well as Customize Mode, which lets you adjust the operation of the powertrain, chassis and air conditioning functions to suit your personal preferences.

F SPORT  PERFORMANCE ENHANCEMENTS
Available exclusively on RX F SPORT  packages, Sport S+ Drive Mode heightens shift response for a more viscerally engaging drive. While F SPORT -exclusive Adaptive Variable Suspension (AVS) — including new front and rear performance dampers — makes automatic and continuous adjustment to shock absorber settings, helping to keep RX planted to the driving surface for exceptional handling and cornering performance.

ACTIVE TORQUE AWD
RX's Active Torque All-Wheel Drive (AWD) system gives you the traction performance that only an AWD system can provide, while featuring the ability to efficiently distribute torque between the front and rear wheels. The result is a crossover that achieves enhanced fuel efficiency while faithfully following your intentions.
The 2020 RX 350 and 450h feature some of our most advanced safety technology – from standard systems like Lexus Safety System+ 2.0 to available systems like Intelligent Clearance Sonar with Rear Cross Traffic Alert.
